title: From dbt Core to dbt v2: How CarGurus unlocked dbt State and AI at scale
description:
How CarGurus moved 80 developers from dbt Core to dbt v2 and dbt State, then built governed AI agents on top. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Jordan Morgan, principal data engineer at CarGurus, and Stephen Thibeault, senior resident solutions architect at dbt Labs, walk through a migration staged as four sequential bets: orchestration, a clean parse on dbt v2, project-by-project cutover, then dbt State. dbt's autofix tooling resolved about 70% of v2 deprecations and reached a clean parse across all three projects in roughly three weeks. With governed data in place, CarGurus built three live AI agents: a PR review agent, a job triage agent, and a conversational analytics agent.

In this session you'll learn:
• How to stage a dbt v1 to v2 migration for 80 developers
• How autofix handles most v2 deprecations
• Which governed AI agents CarGurus built on dbt

Speakers: Jordan Morgan, CarGurus; Stephen Thibeault, dbt Labs

Learn more about the dbt Fusion engine: https://www.getdbt.com/product/fusion
